purpose: Calibrate the conditioned near-far contrast for the 30 top-ranked GOBP sets from the v6 screen plus 3 controls, using a matched-autocorrelation surrogate null around FIXED anchors.

targets.selection: top 30 by own_median from the v6 screen (rank rule declared in contract v6), then 3 controls

controls.CTRL_B_AXIS: 49-gene B panel; circular positive reference (detection signature shares 49/57 genes)
controls.CTRL_MYC_V1: HALLMARK_MYC_TARGETS_V1 (200 genes); clean tumor-intrinsic control, v5 own-arm median -0.0017
controls.CTRL_RANDOM_32: 32 genes sampled uniformly from the GOBP gene union with seed 20261001; noise floor

statistic.arm: own-conditioned (identical to the v6 screen): readout minus its projection on [deciles of the spot's own detection score] + quadratic tissue trend
statistic.distance: edge distance to the nearest anchor spot; Voronoi assignment; own-component ring 1.3*pitch excluded
statistic.bins: 0,100,...,1000 um; >=5 spots per bin per anchor
statistic.section_statistic: median delta over anchors; evaluable if >=8 anchors carry both bins

null.reason_for_fixed_anchors: the conditioned residual is, under the null, a smooth field independent of the anchor geometry; so the correct null keeps the observed anchors fixed and randomises only the field. The v5.0 mixing/re-selection design was built for the RAW statistic and would inflate significance here because the conditioned residual has already had the rho*s component removed. Declared before running.
null.construction: per section and per set: estimate sigma from the lag-band correlations of the observed conditioned residual (bands 100-200/200-400/400-700/700-1000, pairs subsampled to <=200k, reuse one pair list per section); simulate iid Gaussian white noise (n x 200), smooth with a row-normalised Gaussian kernel exp(-d^2/(2 sigma^2)) truncated at 3 sigma, standardise columns, quantile-map each column to the marginal distribution of the observed residual; compute the near-far contrast around the fixed observed anchors; section null = median over anchors
null.sigma_fallback: if sigma cannot be fitted (fewer than 2 usable lag bands) the section is dropped and counted

claim_rule.per_set: halo claimed only if (a) >=50% of evaluable sections have p <= 0.05, (b) >=8 evaluable sections, (c) median observed delta > median of the per-section null medians
claim_rule.controls_expected: CTRL_RANDOM_32 should give p approximately uniform (no claim); CTRL_MYC_V1 flat; CTRL_B_AXIS reported as the circular reference, not a claim
claim_rule.no_claim_without_composition_control: even a positive result stays 'field-shaped co-variation' until the composition control (C6 covariates) is run

raw_arm_reference.scope: the v5.0 mixing/re-selection null is run for the 3 controls only, to show the machinery reproduces the v5 control behaviour; the raw arm for the 30 targets is not re-run (v5 already calibrated that statistic on 51 Hallmark/B sets)
